UC Berkeley / vLLM Team is listed as a university lab rather than a for-profit company, with github.com given as its website. The text harvested from that address is GitHub's own description of its platform, which it calls the world's most widely adopted, AI-powered developer platform, where developers, businesses, and the largest open source community build software. That text describes GitHub, not the team, so it says nothing about the team's own work or organization.
